video_format.description: short = 30-55s 9:16 Short with replay loop; long_form = 3-15+ min multi-act episode (9:16 vertical micro-drama or 16:9 horizontal YouTube video) with multi-voice cast, Act-aware BGM, and chunked QA.

production_mode.description: omni_video = Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash video generation; keyframe_motion = zero-API-key keyframes with 2x-supersampled FFmpeg motion; hybrid = mixes Mode A hero clips with Mode B motion shots via per-shot production_mode.

aspect_ratio.description: 9:16 = 1080x1920 vertical Shorts or serialized micro-dramas; 16:9 = 1920x1080 horizontal long-form YouTube episodes or explainers.

ending_style.description: replay_loop = Shorts dual-anchor loop back to Shot 1; cliffhanger = serialized multi-episode drama hook; outro = standalone long-form conclusion/CTA.

voice.description: Default/fallback neural TTS voice (e.g., en-US-AvaNeural, en-US-EmmaNeural, en-GB-SoniaNeural).
WordBoundary-verified edge-tts neural voice (e.g., en-GB-SoniaNeural, en-US-AvaNeural, en-GB-RyanNeural, en-US-EmmaNeural, en-GB-ThomasNeural).

rate.description: Speech rate offset such as '+14%' or '+0%'.

keyword_color.description: Optional speaker-specific ASS BGR hex accent color (e.g., '&H00D7FF&') for kinetic captions.

voice_cast.description: Multi-voice speaker map for long-form episodes (maps shot.speaker to voice, rate, pitch, and optional caption accent color).

tts_pronunciations.description: Optional map of clean display strings to phonetic TTS strings (e.g., {"AWS": "A W S", "Pei Xuan": "Pay Shwen", "911": "nine-one-one"}). Applied during TTS synthesis while captions render dialogue_or_vo.

bgm_source.description: retrieved_track = instrumental via retrieve_music.py; procedural = synthesized stem via make_bgm.py; procedural_act_aware = multi-act score locked to shot_timings.json act boundaries.

bgm_query.description: Optional search query or style hint for retrieve_music.py when bgm_source is retrieved_track.

caption_style.description: kinetic_keyword = word-by-word pop with semantic highlights; karaoke_chunk = bounce-pop phrase chunks; clean_subtitle = 16:9 widescreen lower-third subtitles without tilt; none = no burned-in captions (use --export-srt for YouTube CC).

caption_font_size.description: ASS caption font size (defaults: 86 on 1080x1920, 62 on 1920x1080).

caption_margin_v.description: ASS MarginV offset from bottom in px (defaults: 420 on 1080x1920 vertical, 72 on 1920x1080 horizontal).

caption_keyword_color.description: Keyword highlight mode: 'auto' (semantic neon), 'palace' (Imperial Gold / Fiery Crimson-Coral / Pearl Cyan-Jade), or an ASS BGR hex code.

highlight_keywords.description: Optional top-level words, names, or numbers to emphasize in kinetic captions.

character_references_path.description: Optional path to Stage 0 character_references.json with verified portraits, visual traits, and official mascot specs.

style_bible.description: Verbatim rendering, lighting, camera, and palette block appended to every shot prompt. Forbid signage with 'unadorned facades, plain empty surfaces, zero letters, zero digits, zero signage' (never 'blank signs').

acts.description: Optional multi-act / chapter outline for long-form episodes (used for modular act authoring, Act-aware BGM dynamics, and YouTube chapter export).

act_file.description: Optional modular act JSON path (e.g., acts/act_01.json).

natural_speech_passed.description: True after verifying the script against references/spoken_english_guide.md (full grammar, varied cadence, zero AI_SLOP_SCRIPT patterns).

max_caption_chars.description: Max characters per caption line (defaults: 18 on 1080x1920 at 86px; 36 on 1920x1080 at 62px).

state_sheets.description: Optional map of costume/visual states to locked turnaround sheet paths (e.g., {"veiled": "sheets/hero_veiled.png", "unveiled": "sheets/hero.png"}).

continuity_notes.description: Optional progressive damage, wardrobe, or prop continuity notes tracked across Acts and into the next episode.

reference_image_path.description: Optional path to Stage 0 verified portrait or official mascot reference image.

likeness_verified.description: True after checking the character's visual traits and turnaround sheet against Stage 0 references.

act.description: Act or chapter number (1..N) for long-form episodes.

production_mode.description: Optional per-shot override when top-level production_mode is hybrid.

character_states.description: Optional per-character state sheet selector for this shot (e.g., {"lin_wanyin": "veiled"}).

speaker.description: Optional speaker key referencing top-level voice_cast for multi-voice episodes.

voice.description: Optional per-shot neural TTS voice override.

rate.description: Optional per-shot TTS speech rate override (e.g., '+14%').

post_gap_sec.description: Optional silence pause after this shot (e.g., 0.25 at Act breaks, 0.0 on the final shot).

dialogue_or_vo.description: Spoken narration or dialogue in clean display English and natural speech without AI slop or dropped grammar; drives captions (see references/spoken_english_guide.md).

tts_text.description: Optional phonetic override for TTS synthesis on this shot while dialogue_or_vo drives display captions.

highlight_keywords.description: Optional per-shot words or numbers to highlight in kinetic captions.

dual_anchor_loop.description: True on the final shot of a Short to pass both the character sheet and shot_01 keyframe for replay loops. Keep false on long-form episodes.

loop_bridge.description: Final spoken phrase that connects naturally into Shot 1's opening line (required for Shorts; omit for long-form episodes).
